newsitem.title: DUBAI: OPEC meeting to seek market stability - UAE's Rakad.
newsitem.headline: OPEC meeting to seek market stability - UAE's Rakad.

text.p: OPEC ministers who will meet on November 27 in Vienna will discuss ways to acheive a balance in the international oil market, the United Arab Emirates acting oil minister said on Sunday.

"OPEC will explore current developments in the oil markets and the measures that will allow it to maintain its interests and the achievement of balance in the international oil market," the official WAM news agency quoted Rakad bin Salem bin Rakad as saying before his departure for the meeting.
He said the UAE, current chairman of the 11-member club, would use its position to reach positive results to guarantee continued stability in the oil market.
Rakad is also the OPEC president.

OPEC ministers will set the group's output ceiling for at least the first six months of next year. Gulf sources and OPEC delegates have said it is unlikely that the group would change the present quota.
The UAE has said it would not be pushing for a rise in its OPEC quota of 2.161 million barrels per day at the Vienna meeting.
